the move

TODO-412 proved the ceiling: Strava's API hard-caps the canvas — read-daily 1000 gates uploads to ~200–300/day, no photo-upload API, no delete API. So this session built the thing the caps can't touch: a near-1:1 clone over ~/.strava-archive directly. No API. No quotas. Photos inline. The Omar trickle keeps running behind it untouched.

found: index.json silently omits ~300 fully-archived activities (<2025-11-21). The catalog scans activities/*/metadata.json instead — the complete truth, 4,892 entries.
rule: archive + ark are read-only; strava-nix daemons write there any minute — reads retry mid-write races.
rule: start_date_local's Z is fake — every timestamp renders through getUTC* helpers.

feedroute maps · enrichment chips · dashboards inline

activitythe thing Strava blocks

training logbubble grid · race rings

profiletrophy case · lifetime band · PRs · physiology

how it holds together

piecewhat it does
src/lib/catalog.tsscans every populated activity dir (metadata + activity + enrichments + photos manifests) → 4,892-entry normalized catalog; 716 ms cold, disk-cached, 5-min TTL, invalidates on dir-count change
src/lib/derive.tsrollups mirrored from strava-nix stats.ts: weekly buckets (Mon start, wall-clock days), per-sport YTD/all-time/4-week, run PRs from best_efforts, lifetime type breakdown
src/lib/photos.tsphoto bytes: ark_path → ~/ark/photos; null ark_path → photos.db (node:sqlite, read-only) source_path fallback; HEIC→jpeg via sips, cached
/api/v3/*Strava-compatible read surface — athlete, activities paging (before/after/per_page), detail verbatim, keyed streams, laps, stats; 404 bodies byte-alike. If quotas ever open, sync is trivial — but we barely need them now
/media/*dashboards (4,592 pre-rendered JPEGs) + photos/videos with HTTP Range 206
cohortssv (1,321 Strava mirror: dense streams, laps, splits, polylines) · ah (3,571 Apple-Health decade: sparse HR-vs-time, manual) — every page degrades per cohort
